title: Around 1,500 soldiers on standby for deployment to Minneapolis, officials say
summary: The troops are an option should Donald Trump decide to use them to quell anti-ICE protests in the city, an official tells CBS News.

title: A deadly fire swept through a nightclub in just 90 seconds. I got out
summary: Twenty-two years before the Swiss ski resort fire, Gina escaped a near-identical disaster. Would you know what to do if it happened to you?
